summary: Added docshelf/access.py per docs/access.md and moved every access check of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit into it; each now has a module-level RULES, store.py/render.py/errors.py are untouched, and tests/test_access.py was added. The 31 tests pass, and a differential fuzz against the original package (about 18,000 command runs over random workspaces) showed no difference in output, exit status or workspace files. Behavior that looks like a bug was kept as it is: the commands disagree on role-name case and spaces, suspension end day, grant and delegation end minute, empty teams, `*` grants and delegate rights, and share and delete treat any suspended account as suspended.
